learner_operation: Normalize the ODE, integrate P to identify I, integrate I Q, divide by I, and impose the initial value; distinguish distractors by these dependencies rather than choice layout.

fixed_features.feature: Two select fields: integrating factor and particular solution
fixed_features.justification: All nine source banks request these quantities; preserve response workload.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary small constant P=a (e.g. 1 and 2), retaining Q=a b; derive I=exp(a x), y=b+(h-b)exp(-a x). Both use exactly the same integration and initial-value steps.
answer_roles.observed: easy_constant enforces a=1 in sampler and check_parameters. All 66 eligible current tasks key e^x. The otherwise valid a=2 is rejected.

answer_roles.role: Particular solution and sign of homogeneous term
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary forcing equilibrium b and initial value h so y and sign of h-b change.
answer_roles.observed: 66 valid tasks; 51 negative and 15 positive homogeneous constants. This is useful variation of the second field; it does not remove the first-field shortcut.

shortcut_probes.strategy: Choose the literal e^x in field-1 without inspecting any ODE or initial value.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 100% versus uniform four-option guessing at 25%; fixed I comes from a=1 construction, not from applying I=exp(integral P). This is a partial-question shortcut, not a claim of 100% full-question success. Native engine accepts this action on all 66.
